wallpaper.configuration.emissiveLighting: Whether wallpaper made from light emitting blocks (glowstone, sea lantern) lights up the world.
wallpaper.configuration.multiPlacement.t: Whether sneak + click lets players fill a rectangular area with wallpaper at once.
Whether sneaking with the scraper removes all connected wallpaper at once.
wallpaper.configuration.blockRotation.to: Whether logs, pillars and directional blocks can be rotated after being applied as wallpaper.
wallpaper.configuration.maxMultiPlaceAre: Maximum number of blocks a single multi placement can cover.
wallpaper.configuration.maxVeinMineBlock: Maximum number of wallpapers a single scraper vein mine can remove.
wallpaper.configuration.selectionTimeout: How long a multi placement corner selection stays active before expiring.
wallpaper.configuration.consumeItems.too: Whether placing wallpaper consumes items from the player's inventory (survival only).
wallpaper.configuration.returnItemsOnRem: Whether scraping wallpaper returns the wallpaper/block item to the player (survival only).
wallpaper.configuration.maxRenderDistanc: Maximum distance (in blocks) at which wallpaper is rendered. Set to 0 for unlimited.
